vendorLabel: Toll fraud operation targeting Poland (confirmed + code-linked apps)
evidence: Android packages of the toll fraud operation targeting Poland (confirmed fraud builds and code-linked loader apps distributed via Google Play after Meta ads). Recovered builds share loader design, hidden host components, WHOIS records, OSS object names and C2 infrastructure.
